item.name: Disposable_Food_Gloves
item.description: Choice powder-free clear disposable poly foodservice gloves, large, 100 count.
item.readyBeforeUse: A clean pair is available and fits the worker.
item.ifNotReady: Do not touch ready-to-eat food. Ask the Food Lead for gloves that fit.

problem.condition: A glove tears or touches hair, a face, a phone, trash, money, or another unclean surface.
problem.response: Remove it, wash both hands, and put on new gloves before touching food.
